snippet.title: Forgotten Eras Demo | Cinematic Trailer (ENG)
snippet.description:
In Forgotten Eras, you play as Ivan, guided by the Grey Wolf, as you face Domovoy, Kolobok, and Baba Yaga, cursed spirits that have been lost in the enchanted forests.

Living fairytale crafted with love, inspired by myths, art, and timeless stories.

🎮 Wishlist Forgotten Eras on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3423760/Forgotten_Eras 
💫 Support us on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/behindthehump/forgotten-eras-a-mythical-journey-through-slavic-folklore 
📖 Explore more: Artbook, Comic, Cookbook, Prints, 3D Collectibles, all part of our campaign! https://behindthehump.com/ 

📌 Follow Us
